readme:
# Google News Scraper

Scrape news articles from [Google News](https://news.google.com) for any search query. Extract article titles, publisher names, publication dates, and direct article links.

## What data do you get?

For each news article, the scraper extracts:

- **Article title** (cleaned, without source suffix)
- **Source/publisher name** (e.g., "Reuters", "CNN", "TechCrunch")
- **Publisher URL** (e.g., "https://www.reuters.com")
- **Article URL** (`url` is the Google News link; `article_url` is the real publisher URL decoded from it)
- **Publisher domain**, language and country of the search
- **Publication date** (`published_at` and `published_at_iso` in ISO 8601 UTC, plus `published_at_text` with the raw feed string)
- **Search query** that matched the article

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/google-news-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `google-news-scraper` to scrape company data from google news. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## How to use

### Basic usage

Set one or more **Search Queries** and run. The scraper fetches Google News results for each query.

### Input example

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["artificial intelligence", "climate change"],
  "language": "en",
  "country": "US",
  "maxResults": 100,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 50
}
```

### Input parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `searchQueries` | array | Search keywords to find news articles (default: "artificial intelligence") |
| `language` | string | Language code for results (default: "en") |
| `country` | string | Country code for regional results (default: "US") |
| `maxResults` | integer | Maximum total articles to scrape (default: 100) |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Maximum articles per query (default: 50, max ~100) |

### Supported languages

Use standard language codes: `en`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `it`, `pt`, `ja`, `ko`, `zh-CN`, `ar`, `ru`, etc.

### Supported countries

Use ISO country codes: `US`, `GB`, `DE`, `FR`, `CH`, `AT`, `JP`, `KR`, `CN`, `BR`, `IN`, etc.

## Output example

```json
{
  "title": "OpenAI launches new reasoning model",
  "source": "Reuters",
  "source_url": "https://www.reuters.com",
  "source_domain": "reuters.com",
  "url": "https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi...",
  "article_url": "https://www.reuters.com/technology/openai-launches-new-reasoning-model/",
  "url_resolved": true,
  "snippet": null,
  "published_at": "2026-03-31T14:30:00Z",
  "published_at_text": "Mon, 31 Mar 2026 14:30:00 GMT",
  "published_at_iso": "2026-03-31T14:30:00Z",
  "language": "en",
  "country": "US",
  "image_url": null,
  "search_query": "artificial intelligence",
  "source_platform": "google-news",
  "scraped_at": "2026-04-01T10:00:00Z"
}
```

## Tips

- Each query returns up to ~100 articles from the Google News RSS feed.
- Proxying is handled automatically by the actor; no proxy settings are needed.
- Set `country` and `language` to target specific regional news (e.g., `DE`/`de` for German news).
- Results are deduplicated across queries by article URL.
- `article_url` is the real publisher URL when `url_resolved` is true (default; `resolveArticleUrls`), otherwise null; `url` is always the Google News link. Set `resolveArticleUrls` to false for the fastest run.
- Use `timeRange` (1h, 1d, 7d, 30d, 1y) to restrict to recent articles (adds Google's `when:` operator).

## Pricing

This actor uses pay-per-result pricing:

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Per news article | $0.001 |
